INSERT INTO JOB_APPLY ( apply_idx, posting_idx, user_idx, resume_idx, status, apply_date, message ) VALUES ( #{applyIdx}, #{postingIdx}, #{userIdx}, #{resumeIdx}, '열람대기', SYSDATE, #{message, jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
mapper.select:
SELECT a.apply_idx AS applyIdx, a.posting_idx AS postingIdx, a.status, a.apply_date AS applyDate,
p.title, p.employer, p.pay, p.pay_type AS payType
FROM JOB_APPLY a JOIN job_posting p ON a.posting_idx = p.posting_idx
WHERE a.user_idx = #{userIdx} ORDER BY a.apply_date DESC

SELECT ja.apply_idx AS applyIdx, ja.posting_idx AS postingIdx, ja.user_idx AS userIdx, ja.status, ja.message, ja.apply_date AS applyDate,
u.name AS applicantName, u.tel AS applicantPhone
FROM job_apply ja
JOIN users u ON ja.user_idx = u.USERIDX
WHERE ja.posting_idx = #{postingIdx}
ORDER BY ja.apply_idx DESC
